mostWorthwhile.text: Making the supporting tissue was most worthwhile: it showed that cells can release proteins to build material around themselves, unlike the muscle cells' internal bundles.

leastWorthwhile.text: Starting the supporting cells repeated the muscle-cell pattern, so it felt less novel, although the comparison was useful.

surprise.text: I was surprised that the supporting cells built fibres around themselves rather than keeping the proteins inside, as the muscle cells did.

arbitrary.text: Nothing felt especially arbitrary. The signals were named for their outcomes, though how they caused different genes to become active wasn't explained.

continue.text: I would choose to continue: seeing the same DNA lead to different cell jobs was interesting, and I'd like to see how these cells fit into larger structures.
